skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Bard's Holiday
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bard's Holiday. Trendy autumn attire, loose and breathable. Incorporates a unique multi-layer pocket design, convenient for holding all sorts of lightweight souvenirs during a serendipitous sojourn.
skins.quote: The bowstring trembles, the chord sounds, the wind leaves behind stories in its wake.

skins.name: Gwiazdcytrony
skins.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Gwiazdcytrony. Meteor's winter clothes from back in Kazimierz. Balancing lightness and warmth, they also allow one to easily hide in dense forests. A reproduction.
skins.quote: Gwiazdcytron trees can only grow in Kazimierz. In the times they still remember, the forest wardens are warm and safe, just like their hometown.
